---
title: Roadmap
---

The build-out runs in three gates. One gate = one named milestone: it ships
when its scenarios pass and their evidence posts ([ADR-0002](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-release-gates.md)).
The live board carries the same set of cards:
[agentpcap — Roadmap & Build Board](https://github.com/users/shsingh/projects/7).

## Current phase

`2026.01-rc1` gate evidence complete: the six-measurement set ran on the
build VM — M001 recall `1.0` on the seeded fleet, M002 overhead under
the 3% figure at `2.164%` CPU / `−0.23%` wall, M003's matrix answering
three covered transports with one named gap (the fourth reports the
gap without an exchange), M004 fidelity
kind-for-kind, M005 precision `1.0`, M006 handoff at `≈0.02–0.04 s`
against the 2-second budget ([the gate
report](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/releases/2026.01-rc1.md),
[the review-bot sweep](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/pull/112)).
The remaining gap rides [#83](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/issues/83)
(the legacy-SSE capture face); the parked research faces
([#76](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/issues/76),
[#55](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/issues/55)) stay open with
their receipts. The gate PR carries the release notes; the signed tag
`2026.01-rc1` and the attested build follow the merge. The
general-availability gate (`2026.01`) starts next.

## Release gates

| Gate | Scenario | Measures |
|---|---|---|
| 2026.01-alpha1 | one lab host, one stdio MCP client and server | ledger chain verifies after rotation; no path writes; tool messages present in the ledger |
| 2026.01-alpha2 | the fleet plus remote Streamable HTTP, attributed mode active on every host | M003 coverage matrix; M004 capability drift |
| 2026.01-rc1 | full fleet with seeded shadow deployments | M001 recall, M002 overhead delta, M003 full matrix, M004 fidelity, M005 triage precision, M006 handoff latency — gate rule: M001 passing with M003 at M002 cost |

## The measurement set

The six measurements map to the evaluation issues above: M001 → #26,
M002 → #25, M003 → #27, M004 → #28, M005 → #29, M006 → #30. Baselines come
from the published figures of the
[research note](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/agentpcap-paper.md).
